gates.requires: Reviewed distal kinematics, independent roll/pitch/yaw/grip, atomic refusal/rollback, blade sweep and post-advance interlocks; replayable P0 regression evidence.
Reproducible FMA/name/complete element mapping, per-OBJ nonempty v/f and SHA256, plus source file hashes. Audit pass does not open other gates.
Expert-reviewed distinction of three fasciae, source annotation, transform/units/landmarks and validated ROI. If synthetic, label it explicitly and limit claims.
Document preset exposure and retained bladder; verify occlusion, protection and reachability without deleting anatomy.
Explicit NVB model uncertainty and deforming risk-region correspondence with failure/stop tests; not a clinical safety envelope.
Freeze seeds, initial conditions, budgets, success/failure definitions and paired active-view/traction ablations before experiments.
Independent measured material/cutting data, parameter identification, uncertainty and held-out validation; no calibrated parameters yet.

limitations: Basic nonempty v/f, finite xyz and vertex-index checks only; no topology validation.
Source hashes identify bytes; they do not authenticate an official release or license.
Fascia/NVB alias matching is not anatomical annotation; candidate hits need review.
No world coordinates, scene registration, deformation or material calibration generated.
Synthetic proxy; preset exposure with bladder retained, not removed.
NVB model risk region is not a clinically safe envelope.

reproducibility.deduplication: OBJ basename, not FMA, not byte content
reproducibility.ordering: sorted IDs/OBJ names; no timestamps or absolute asset paths

scope: Source asset integrity only; not ROI/registration, clinical safety or P1/P4 acceptance.

structures.absence_scope: Named entries/aliases in the supplied tables only; not clinical anatomy.
